metadata.case_name: POON CHI SANG LOUIS v. J.V. FITNESS LTD T/A CALIFORNIA FITNESS

plaintiff.occupation_before: sergeant of the Hong Kong Police Force

injuries.description: soft tissue wound laceration as well as contusion injury over the anterior and distal aspect of plaintiff’s right leg
injuries.body_part: anterior and distal aspect of right leg
source: Dr. Miu diagnosed that the Accident resulted in soft tissue wound laceration as well as contusion injury over the anterior and distal aspect of plaintiff’s right leg.
injuries.icd_description: Laceration without foreign body of lower leg

manifestations.description: reduced exercise tolerance / exercise performance impaired
healed scar over anterior distal right leg running obliquely measuring 8 cm with slight increase in pigmentation (not hypertrophic) and mild swelling around it

treatments_received: tetanus vaccine (first dose administered; second and third doses later)
silicone gel sheet for scar reduction

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Interruption and reduction of sporting activities (weight training, boxing, station bike, running); ceased bicycle training for some time; fearful of riding fitness bicycle; plan of getting trained as a part-time coach deferred; exercise tolerance impaired.
Left with a scar about 2 to 3 inches long on right shin; silicone gel sheet did not work well.

comparable_cases.case_name: Lee Yau Wai v. Yeung Kam Wing
comparable_cases.injury_description: Several surgical procedures for right wrist and left knee, including wrist arthroscopy, reconstruction of ligament, debridement and left knee operation; victim "gave up" various vigorous sports.

comparable_cases.case_name: Poon Man Chun v. Li Sau Yee
comparable_cases.injury_description: Large open wound over right knee and leg; operated with fractured knee-cap fixed with screws; several more operations followed; walked with slight limp and left with unsightly knee scars; could no longer swim breaststrokes or butterfly; could no longer continue job.

comparable_cases.case_name: Ng Ka Ho (an infant) v Yeung Kwok Leung
comparable_cases.injury_description: Head injuries without loss of consciousness; minor right knee injuries without fracture treated with suturing and discharged same day; dizziness and vomiting; mild post-traumatic distress symptoms; aggravation of pervasive developmental disorder.

comparable_cases.case_name: Wong Ming Kwan v. Wing Ming Electrical Company Limited and others
comparable_cases.injury_description: Right leg severely cut causing lacerations with tendon exposed; complete cut of right anterior tibial artery, deep peroneal nerve, anterior tibial tendon, extensor hallux longus tendon and extensor digitorum longus tendon; operation performed to repair artery, nerve and tendons; post-op brace and crutches; ankle-foot orthosis; intensive physiotherapy; pressure stocking for knee scars; over 2 years of sick leave; residual pain, stiffness and numbness.

comparable_cases.case_name: Mahmood Tariq v Kinway Engineering Ltd & Anor
comparable_cases.injury_description: Fall from height with back sprain and right knee contusion; discharged after 2 days; analgesics and 15 sessions of physiotherapy; total sick leave of over 12 months; experts noted signs of symptom exaggeration.

comparable_cases.case_name: Chung Wai Hung v Chung Wai Ming
comparable_cases.injury_description: 7-cm cut wound over left anterior knee deep to proximal tibia with tear of patella tendon and contamination; operation with metal debris removal, debridement and tendon repair; knee brace post-op; discharged after 9 days; residual persistent left knee pain, walking with slight limp, inability to run or squat, difficulty straightening left leg or ascending/descending stairs without pain; 6-cm scar; inability to play table tennis, swimming or riding bicycle.
